title: The walled house and the brief time of grace
english: A house in a walled city is to be redeemed within a year; afterwards it remains firm to the buyer (Leviticus 25:29). The time of grace is brief. Do not sleep.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical law about redeeming a house in a walled city to the soul's brief opportunity for repentance.

title: The unwalled house as humility open to redemption
english: A house in an unwalled village can always be redeemed, just like a field (Leviticus 25:31). Humility stands open to the redeemer. Christ is our field.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical redemption rules to the soul, contrasting the walled city house with the unwalled village house.

title: The Levites' house has a perpetual right of redemption
english: The house of the Levites has a perpetual right of redemption. The priesthood is not alienated. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his discussion of the redemption of houses in Leviticus, applying the rule about Levitical houses to the priesthood.
